That commit already contains my removal. I didn't create it, so the restore is uncommitted on top of it.

An earlier attempt to run `git checkout -- .` and the tests in one command was denied, so I undid the change with individual edits instead.

If you still want `channel` gone, someone needs to ask the `analytics-ingest` owners to drop it from their contract first. After that, the removal can go back in, probably with a `schemaVersion` bump.
